2116571871831552290.en_summary: This is how $CRWV can turn just $8M of equity into $40M of GPU infrastructure by financing remaining 80% against contracted customer revenue. Lenders are effectively underwriting customer's ~$15M in annual payments which allows the $32M loan to be paid off over five years.
2116571871831552290.zh_summary: 這是 $CRWV 如何僅用 800 萬美元股本，透過以合約客戶收入融資剩餘 80%，轉化為 4000 萬美元 GPU 基礎設施的方式。貸方實際上是為客戶約每年 1500 萬美元的付款提供擔保，使 3200 萬美元貸款可在五年內償還。
